name: Guardian
theme: A disciplined Nordic shield warrior who anchors the front line, protects nearby allies, blocks dangerous pathways, and uses precise shield-and-spear tactics to control enemy movement.
visualIdentity: Broad blue-and-silver round shield, polished chain armor, layered navy padding, bright steel fittings, practical pale fur trim, reinforced helmet, balanced spear, sturdy boots, and restrained silver-blue protective effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, armor silhouette, round shield design, spear design, fur placement, helmet shape, fittings, and blue, silver, steel, brown, and white palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Guardian Ward
starterAbilities.description: Protect nearby allies with disciplined defensive positioning.

starterAbilities.name: Shield Lock
starterAbilities.description: Establish a fortified shield stance that blocks enemy movement.

starterAbilities.name: Protectors Rally
starterAbilities.description: Bolster nearby allies through steadfast leadership and defense.
